en: This gem once allowed direct communication with Elune, herself.
Feeling better I see.
Whoa...Whoa..Aaaaahhh!
We will suffer no demon's servant in our lands!
Greetings.  I am Chronos - He Who Never Forgets.  My memory is without flaw, and exact to the most minor detail.$B$BTrust me.
Good work! We're almost there, $N. This way.
Guards to your posts! They must be after the Magistrate again. He must be protected! They could come from any direction!
Well yes, I do know a rare alchemical recipe.  Let me teach you!
Kalaran, please enchant the torch.
I seek to understand the importance of strength of the body.

Ahoy, $n! Not a pretty picture, is it?$B$BThe Horizon Scout at the bottom of the sea, my crew in shambles, and our cargo and passengers strewn about like so much debris that you'd think this was one of Stormwind's canals after a festival.$B$BAnd that's not where the trouble ends...
Pick the berries from the windblossom.
The Scarlet Crusade is encroaching on our homeland.  The foolish zealots do not realize that the loyal servants of The Dark Lady shall see to their demise.
The heat... I can't take it...
You can't hide from us.  Prepare to burn!
Leaping leper gnomes! I've been stuck in there for months. Thanks, gang.
Ah!  My wounds are too severe.  Defenders, fight on without me!
I believe the Forsaken are misleading the allies of the Horde.... wait... I feel so... dizzy...
I am no cultist, you monster!  Come to me and face your destruction!
Spraggle! I didn't think I'd make it back!
Gremlock doesn't always have the best of luck with cooking, but he does have some tasty recipies worth learning.  Go chat him up in the Thunderbrew Distillery and see what he'll teach ye.
A corruption taints our sacred forest.
Defend Nighthaven, hero...
How many more supplies are needed to rebuild our base?
Um, I'm taking some prisoners we found outside before the king for punishment.
Where is it ye would like to go $g lad : lass;? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.
Can you tell me what is happening on Zephras Isle?
Best drinks in Stormwind!
I think... I think it's working!
Now we just have to free Tobias and we can get out of here. This way!
Durtham Greldon over in The Forlorn Cavern can teach ye the in's and out's of lockpicking.  Just don't be practicing any of those in's or out's here in Ironforge, if ye understand my meaning.
Ah, the sweet salt air of Ratchet.
Brother Wilhelm often trains with Lyria Du Lac out in back of the smithy in Goldshire.  You could probably learn a thing or two about being a paladin from him.
(Continue.)
No time for beer!  The race is about to start.
I'm sorry, I'm a bit busy right now making horseshoes for Verner Osgood in Lakeshire.
I heard a story about this golden fish, and if you caught it you would get three wishes!
The centaur clans rule the wastes of Desolace.  If united, they would be a terrible force.  It is then good that the centaur clans are not united but instead bicker and war amongst themselves.
Mark my words!  You won't find faster gryphons anywhere in the Eastern Kingdoms than the ones right here in Thelsamar!
Ah, $n, don't cry. Lucky for you, when last you gave me the amulet, I attuned myself to it. I'll just summon it back from wherever you dropped it.$B$BTry looking in your bags now.
Be careful, $n.  Those wolves like to hide among the trees.

Sure thing, $n. You look like you can be trusted... Trustworthy! I can spot that a mile away...$B$BAnyway, back to what I was sayin'. Takes one Evoroot plant to make the Videre Elixir. The rest 'a the ingredients are trivial really, but the Evoroot, well, that can be a bit tricky to get.
Here, $n.  Take a chest of containment coffers and a cantation of manifestation.  You will need them for your mission.
Did my sweet lass Kali send you down to me? The apple of my eye, she is.
We are under siege!  To arms!  Kill this $n!

Ye might not know it, but in addition to being a skilled tailor, Jormund is also a slayer of giants!  Why he must have overheard a few of us sharing stories when he shouted that he'd killed seven with one blow!  

Ye should pay him a visit at his store on the north side of The Great Forge an' see if he'll tell ye the tale!
%s exchanges quiet words with $n, and hands $ghim:her; a small object.
